messages:
Priya: Quick proposal — small cohort sampling + a lightweight priority matrix so we can start partner outreach today.
Cameron: Drop the sampling doc pls :eyes:
Priya: https://redwood-internal/notes/dp-sample-v3 (WIP). Short summary: 4 workload lanes, quota-based invites, 2-tier feedback cadence.
Jamie: Which lanes exactly? one-liner please.
Priya: Interactive low-latency, high-throughput vector/embeddings, long-context/summary, private/VPC & regulated.
Ana: Ops suggestion: 5 partners per lane (20 total) — manageable for run coordination and gives cross-signal.
Mike: Heads-up: private/VPC partners need legal + infra prep ~2-3 weeks. We should stagger invites.
Priya: Proposed "ready" acceptance criteria for counting a partner run:
- Integration completed within 5 business days
- 3 successful end-to-end runs of their primary flow
- No P0/P1 incidents in those runs
- Short post-run feedback form completed
Cameron: Feedback cadence idea: weekly 10-min pulse (yes/no + top issue) + biweekly 45-min deep-dive per lane. Telemetry export to S3 after runs.
Jamie: For prioritization, score signals: severity(40), frequency(30), customer-impact(30). Use a threshold to promote items to roadmap backlog.
Ana: Also capture "onboarding friction" as its own signal bucket — keeps infra/ops issues separate from model-quality signals.
Priya: Rollout gate example: if >=70% of partners in a lane report no critical regressions and median onboarding <=3 days, we greenlight wider rollout.
Mike: Resource note: long-context runs consume Dedicated pool. Estimate ~120-180 GPU-hours for the cohort. Need capacity reservation.
Priya: I'll open a short reservation request. OpsBot: please create ticket.
DeployBot: reservation_request_created: ticket RD-4910 for 150 GPU-hours (pending approval).
Cameron: I'll own outreach and initial screening for interactive + embeddings lanes.
Ana: I'll run the weekly pulse collection and synthesize the biweekly notes into the priority matrix doc.
Jamie: I'll track acceptance criteria and maintain the escalation playbook.
Mike: I'll follow up on legal checklist and GPU reservation status.
Priya: Can volunteers drop available screening slots this week? I added 30m slots on my calendar.
Cameron: Added.
Ana: Added. I'll also share the one-page feedback template by EOD.
Mike: I'll ping infra on the reservation and loop in legal.
Priya: Awesome. Once we lock partners I'll update the sampling sheet and post a short recap in #product. :thumbsup:
